in_sanskrit.name: Sharhud
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Royal, Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharhud एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharhud is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shar' meaning royal and 'Hud' meaning victory. This name is a tribute to the royal and victorious nature of the person it is given to. It suggests a strong and powerful individual with a deep sense of wisdom.
